```{r echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
omdb <- GET('http://www.omdbapi.com/?apikey=b6c9c053&t=Shaolin-Soccer')|>
  content(as = 'text', encoding = 'UTF-8')|>
  fromJSON(flatten =TRUE)

str(omdb)
```

| Variable | Data Type | Description |
| `Title` | Character | The official title of the movie (e.g., "Shaolin Soccer"). |
| `Year` | Character | The release year of the movie. |
| `Rated` | Character | The motion picture content rating. |
| `Released` | Character | The exact date the movie was released in theaters. |
| `Runtime` | Character | The duration of the movie, including units. |
| `Genre` | Character | A comma-separated list of genres (e.g., "Action, Adventure"). |
| `Director` | Character | The director of the movie. |
| `Writer` | Character | The writer or screenplay author. |
| `Actors` | Character | The main cast or lead actors. |
| `Plot` | Character | A brief synopsis of the movie's plot. |
| `Language` | Character | The language spoken in the movie. |
| `Country` | Character | The country or countries of production. |
| `Awards` | Character | A summary of awards won and nominations received. |
| `Poster` | Character | A URL link to the movie's promotional poster image. |
| `Ratings` | Data Frame | A data frame containing ratings from various sources. |
| `Metascore` | Character | The aggregate score from Metacritic. |
| `imdbRating` | Character | The average user rating on IMDb. |
| `imdbVotes` | Character | The total number of user votes on IMDb. |
| `imdbID` | Character | The unique identifier for the movie in the IMDb database. |
| `Type` | Character | The type of media. |
| `DVD` | Character | The commercial release date on DVD. |
| `BoxOffice` | Character | The gross box office revenue in North America. |
| `Production` | Character | The production company behind the movie. |
| `Website` | Character | The official website URL for the movie. |
| `Response` | Character | The status of the API query. |
